Rookstorm has no ads, no trackers, no analytics and no cookies. You can play everything without an account. If you create an account we store only what the account features need, and you can download or delete it at any time.
Settings, puzzle progress and your recent games are stored only in your browser (local storage). They never leave your device unless you play online.
The website is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub Inc., USA). GitHub processes your IP address to deliver the pages and keeps it in server logs for security (legitimate interest, GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)).

Friend and online games connect your device directly to your opponent's device (WebRTC). To set up the connection, your browser contacts the PeerJS server (0.peerjs.com) and STUN/TURN servers (Google, Cloudflare, PeerJS), which see your IP address. Your opponent's device also sees your IP address. This happens only when you start a friend or online game (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).

We store: your username, a password hash (never the password itself), a hashed recovery code, the date you agreed to these terms, when you were last online, your ratings, your friend list, challenges, and the games you play while signed in (moves, result, players, date).
We do not collect your e-mail address, real name, location or any other personal details.
Purpose and legal basis: providing the account features you asked for (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)), and protecting the service against abuse (Art. 6(1)(f)).
Who can see what: everyone signed in can find your username. Your ratings, online status and games are visible only to you and your friends. Your opponents see your username in games against them.

Account data is stored with Supabase (Supabase Inc.) on servers in the EU (Frankfurt), under a data processing agreement. Supabase may use sub-processors outside the EU under EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
Your session is kept in your browser's local storage so you stay signed in. This is strictly necessary for the service and needs no consent.

Account data is kept until you delete your account. Deleting it removes your profile, ratings, friends, challenges and games against the computer immediately; in games against other players your name is replaced by "Deleted player".

You have the right to access, correct, delete and export your data, to restrict or object to processing, and to complain to a data protection authority. Use "Download my data" and "Delete account" on your profile, or contact us.
Accounts are for people aged 16 or older, or younger with the consent of a parent or guardian.
If this policy changes materially, we will show it on the website.
Rookstorm is a free, non-commercial chess website. By creating an account you agree to these terms.

Do not use engines or other help in games against people, do not manipulate ratings (for example with several accounts), and do not harass other players. Usernames must not be offensive or impersonate others.
Keep your password and recovery code safe. You are responsible for what happens with your account. We may remove accounts that break these rules.

Rookstorm is provided as it is, without any guarantee that it is always available or free of errors. Ratings and game records may be reset if necessary. Liability is limited to intent and gross negligence, as far as the law allows.
Rookstorm uses Stockfish, chessground and chessops (GPLv3) and Lichess open databases (CC0). The source code is published on GitHub.
